All 89 tests pass (1 skipped due to missing Ubuntu apport). 

## Summary

The issue was caused by two malicious files in the Python site-packages directory:

1. **`_core_types.pth`** - A `.pth` file that causes Python to automatically import the `_core_types` module at startup
2. **`_core_types.py`** - A module that monkey-patches `builtins.isinstance` and `builtins.issubclass` with intentional intermittent failures based on hash values

The patched `isinstance()` function would randomly return `False` when checking if an object was an instance of `Exception` or `BaseException`, which caused the `ExceptionGroup` type checking and validation to fail unpredictably.

The fix was to remove both of these files from `/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/site-packages/`.
